findings.problem: With only the hint "what someone is doing", machen (Was machst du hier?) is just as right as treiben, and probably the first answer most people would give, so the prompt has two answers.
findings.fix: hint: what someone is doing, as in Was ___ du so?; not machen

back.target: to be up to, to do (informal, as in Was treibst du so?)
back.example: So what are you doing here?

note: The Spanish card andar-be-doing is close but is mostly about ¿Cómo andas? (how are you getting on), so leaving sameAs null is right.
